Application Materials.content:
Application Materials:
- Curriculum vitae
- Official transcripts of academic records
- Two recommendation letters
- Personal statement
- Copy of degree certificates
- Proof of English proficiency (if applicable)

Application Deadlines.content:
Applications for the 2026-2027 academic year open in **September 2025**. Applications will be processed on a rolling basis until all places have been filled and thus **early applications are strongly encouraged**. Please submit all materials before the deadlines:
- Priority round: **31 January 2026**
- Final round: **30 April 2026**

Academic Requirements.content: In addition to the [general requirements](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/requirements) of the Graduate School, applicants should have **majored in Science, Engineering or related fields**.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- English proficiency: **TOEFL 550 (paper-based) / 79 (internet-based), IELTS 6.5, or equivalent qualifications**.
- Application materials include **Proof of English proficiency (if applicable)**.

Program Overview.content:
The MSc in Earth and Environmental Analytics for Sustainability at CUHK prepares the next generation of environmental data scientists by combining traditional Earth system science with advanced computational methods, artificial intelligence, and data analytics. Students gain expertise in handling diverse environmental datasets, from satellite imagery to sensor networks, while developing proficiency in environmental modeling and ESG analysis.
The programme features world-class faculty, state-of-the-art computational facilities, and strong industry connections. Through project-based learning and industry collaboration, students work on actual environmental challenges. An optional research pathway allows talented students to pursue publication-quality research, preparing them for either professional careers or academic pursuits.
Programme structure includes **five required courses** and **three elective courses**. The normative study period is:
- Full-time: 1 year
- Part-time: 2 years
Graduates may pursue roles in environmental consulting, government agencies, research institutions, or corporate sustainability. Relevant areas include climate risk assessment, environmental monitoring, ESG analysis, and sustainable urban planning.

Curriculum.content:
Programme structure courses:
**Required (five courses):**
- Statistical methods and data analysis
- Numerical methods and modeling
- Machine learning, AI, and big-data analytics
- Scientific applications in ESG analysis (prepare for EFFAS Certified ESG Analyst, CESGA)
- Frontiers of climate and environmental sciences **OR** Frontiers of applied geophysical sciences
**Electives (three courses from the following):**
- Principles and applications of remote sensing
- System thinking and diagnostics for sustainability
- Climate risk analysis (prepare for EFFAS Climate Risk Analyst, ECRA)
- Cutting-edge topics in Earth and environmental sciences
- Research project
- Advanced research project _(does not count toward credit requirement)_
- Other advanced courses in Earth and environmental sciences
The normative study period is:
- Full-time: 1 year
- Part-time: 2 years

Multiple Applications.content:
You can apply for multiple programmes, but you must submit separate applications and pay the application fees for each programme. The paid application fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. If admitted to multiple programmes, you can only enrol in one. All fees paid to the previous programmes will not be refunded or transferred.
The application fee is **HK$500 per programme** (except for MBA, MBA in Finance and MSc in Finance). The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
You may contact your Graduate Division/Programme first to see if you could defer your admission date. If the deferral is allowed, please complete and return the "Application Form for Deferred Admission” available on the [Online Application System for Postgraduate Programmes](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx) to the relevant Division/Programme after accepting the admission offer online and making the deposit payment. The admission can be deferred for a **maximum of one year from the original admission date**.
You may contact your Graduate Division/Programme to see if your deferral request for acceptance of the admission offer and deposit payment could be accepted. If it is accepted, you may complete and return the "Application Form for Deferred Acceptance of Admission Offer" at the [Online Application System for Postgraduate Programmes](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx) to the respective Division/Programme. Please note that the acceptance of an admission offer **cannot be deferred beyond the admission date**.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
Final year undergraduate can apply for postgraduate programmes admission. Please submit your latest official transcript. If accepted, provide an official final transcript and degree certificate upon admission.
If you have received an admission offer with condition(s), follow the steps in [How to Register](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/registration/how-to-register) for provisional registration. Your student status is not yet confirmed and you will **NOT** be allowed to begin your studies until you have fulfilled all the specified condition(s) and have your academic qualification verified by the deadline mentioned in the Admission Notification.
If you cannot provide document(s) to fulfil the admission condition(s) mentioned in the Admission Notification, your admission offer will be withdrawn. You are also required to have your academic qualifications verified before the admission date.
